title: Collect and upload macOS user crash logs on failure
body:
## PR summary

#32372 crashed in CI while running pytest. I had to make a duplicate #32373 in order to add log collection and diagnose the issue.

This PR makes that log collection permanent so that I can quickly diagnose future crashes in CI.

## AI Disclosure

- I used AI to help write the YAML. I explicitly told it what I wanted it to do.
- I tested and edited the resulting YAML to only include `~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports`.
